# A5 — Two-source check of survey noise in Dhaka (TCB vs WFP)

*Generated by `analysis/notes.py` from `outputs/tables/T_A5_tcb_two_source.csv` (script `analysis/a5_tcb_dhaka.py`).*

**Claim.** For Dhaka Sadar, the reliability of WFP's monthly price changes estimated from an independent second source (TCB daily bulletins) is 0.23–0.54 across items and lentil grades (point estimates), against the autocovariance estimates for all markets of 0.27–0.51 (Table 1, A_main) and 0.67–0.79 (A_trim1). The intervals are too wide to choose between the two noise estimators: the 95% interval contains the item's A_trim1 reliability in 5 of 6 rows; it excludes it only for oil ([0.17, 0.72] vs 0.79). Because TCB pools several markets and grades, this is a lower bound for single-market reliability, so even a low value cannot favour the naive estimator. It does confirm that survey monthly changes carry substantial noise.

| item | tcb_series | n_months | first | last | level_ratio_wfp_tcb_median | corr_changes | rel_two_source | rel_lo | rel_hi | share_zero_wfp_changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rice | rice_coarse:none | 20 | 2021-06 | 2024-12 | 0.989 | 0.139 | 0.231 | -0.269 | 1.608 | 0.150 |
| wheat_flour | wheat_flour_atta_loose:none | 47 | 2021-06 | 2026-07 | 1.221 | 0.288 | 0.427 | 0.129 | 0.963 | 0.404 |
| oil | palm_oil_loose:none | 36 | 2022-08 | 2026-08 | 0.978 | 0.638 | 0.378 | 0.172 | 0.724 | 0.194 |
| lentils | lentil_masur:large_grain | 30 | 2023-09 | 2026-08 | 1.008 | 0.632 | 0.543 | -0.277 | 0.763 | 0.500 |
| lentils | lentil_masur:medium_grain | 30 | 2023-09 | 2026-08 | 0.902 | 0.391 | 0.371 | -0.867 | 1.177 | 0.500 |
| lentils | lentil_masur:small_grain | 30 | 2023-09 | 2026-08 | 0.803 | 0.336 | 0.479 | 0.004 | 2.335 | 0.500 |

**Method.** TCB monthly mean of daily (min+max)/2; WFP = RTFP plain column for Dhaka Sadar. rel = Cov(dWFP, dTCB) / Var(dWFP), valid if the two measurement errors are independent; TCB does not appear in WFP's HDX source list. CIs: moving-block bootstrap (block 3 months, 2,000 draws).

**Caveats.** One market; 20–47 months per item; wide intervals. TCB spans several Dhaka markets and grades, so market-specific movements in WFP's quote count as noise here (a lower bound for single-market reliability). Item specifications differ (wheat flour WFP/TCB level ratio 1.22); which masur grade WFP prices is not documented.
